records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.maxima_propagate_instances#1
records.source: Convert the field to float32, optionally blur it, and find centres with :func:`skimage.feature.peak_local_max`. Use those centres as markers for :func:`skimage.segmentation.watershed` on the negative blurred image. Distinct centres can split touching objects; noise can create extra centres, while smoothing or large centre spacing can remove real ones. No existing primary-object mask is accepted. This implementation has no CellProfiler propagation cost or distance/intensity weighting.
records.context: Convert the microscope field of view to float32, optionally blur it, and find centres with :func:`skimage.feature.peak_local_max`. Use those centres as markers for :func:`skimage.segmentation.watershed` on the negative blurred image. Distinct centres can split touching objects; noise can create extra centres, while smoothing or large centre spacing can remove real ones. No existing primary-object mask is accepted. This implementation has no CellProfiler propagation cost or distance/intensity weighting.
records.translation: 현미경 시야를 float32 로 변환하고 선택적으로 흐리게 한 뒤, :func:`skimage.feature.peak_local_max` 로 중심을 찾습니다. 그 중심을 마커로 사용하여 음수로 바꾼 흐린 이미지에 :func:`skimage.segmentation.watershed` 를 적용합니다. 서로 다른 중심은 맞닿은 객체를 분리할 수 있습니다. 잡음은 여분의 중심을 만들 수 있고, 평활화나 큰 중심 간격은 실제 중심을 없앨 수 있습니다. 기존 일차 객체 마스크는 받지 않습니다. 이 구현에는 CellProfiler 의 전파 비용이나 거리/강도 가중치가 없습니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.maxima_propagate_instances#10
records.source: Gaussian standard deviation in pixels; default 2.0. Positive values smooth both seed finding and growth; zero disables blur. Increasing it can suppress noise peaks or merge real peaks. Make Masks offers 0 to 50; the direct API also skips negative values.
records.context: Gaussian standard deviation in pixels; default 2.0. Positive values smooth both seed finding and growth; zero disables blur. Increasing it can suppress noise peaks or merge real peaks. Make Masks offers 0 to 50; the direct API also skips negative values.
records.translation: 픽셀 단위의 가우시안 표준 편차이며, 기본값은 2.0 입니다. 양수 값은 시드 찾기와 성장을 모두 평활화하며, 영이면 흐림을 끕니다. 값을 키우면 잡음 피크가 억제되거나 실제 피크가 병합될 수 있습니다. Make Masks 는 0 에서 50 까지 제공하며, 직접 API 를 쓰면 음수 값도 건너뜁니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.maxima_propagate_instances#3
records.source: ``seed_fraction`` first partitions the entire image by watershed, then retains pixels at or above ``stop_value`` times their basin's seed intensity. This is an intensity ratio, not a quantile. Adding a background offset changes the relative cut; equal measurements of bright and dim objects are not guaranteed. Trimming can leave disconnected pieces with the same label.
records.context: ``seed_fraction`` first partitions the entire image by watershed, then retains pixels at or above ``stop_value`` times their basin's seed intensity. This is an intensity ratio, not a quantile. Adding a background offset changes the relative cut; equal measurements of bright and dim objects are not guaranteed. Trimming can leave disconnected pieces with the same label.
records.translation: ``seed_fraction`` 은 먼저 watershed 로 이미지 전체를 분할한 뒤, 각 분지의 시드 강도에 ``stop_value`` 를 곱한 값 이상인 픽셀만 유지합니다. 이는 분위수가 아니라 강도 비율입니다. 배경 오프셋을 더하면 상대적 절단 위치가 바뀌며, 밝은 객체와 어두운 객체의 측정이 같다는 보장은 없습니다. 다듬고 나면 같은 레이블을 가진 끊어진 조각이 남을 수 있습니다.

records.source: Two kinds of thing are installed from a click: a segmentation backend, which is a Python package added to the running environment with ``pip`` (DINOCell and SAMCell, :data:`spacr.model_zoo.INSTALLABLE_BACKENDS`), and a Cellpose checkpoint from the model zoo, which is a file downloaded and verified by :func:`spacr.model_zoo.install`. Both can take minutes, so both run off the GUI thread: :class:`PackageInstall` runs ``pip`` as a child process watched from the event loop, and :class:`CheckpointDownload` runs the zoo's download on a worker thread. Each reports progress while it runs and a single result when it ends, and a failure is a message rather than an exception, so a failed install leaves the screen that started it working.
records.context: Two kinds of thing are installed from a click: a segmentation backend, which is a Python package added to the executing environment with ``pip`` (DINOCell and SAMCell, :data:`spacr.model_zoo.INSTALLABLE_BACKENDS`), and a Cellpose checkpoint from the model zoo, which is a file downloaded and verified by :func:`spacr.model_zoo.install`. Both can take minutes, so both run off the main GUI execution path: :class:`PackageInstall` runs ``pip`` as a child process watched from the event loop, and :class:`CheckpointDownload` runs the zoo's download on a background execution unit. It used to run ``pip install "spacr[<backend>]"`` against the environment spaCR is running in; each backend now gets an isolated environment, so the install goes through the Model Zoo's own dialog instead: off the GUI thread, with progress and Cancel, into ``~/.spacr/backends/<name>``, and spaCR's own environment is never changed.
records.context: The destination changed, not the gesture. A greyed row installs itself when it is chosen. It used to execute ``pip install "spacr[<backend>]"`` against the environment spaCR is executing in; each backend now gets an isolated environment, so the install goes through the Model Zoo's own dialog instead: off the main GUI execution path, with progress and Cancel, into ``~/.spacr/backends/<name>``, and spaCR's own environment is never changed.

records.label: spacr.qt.night_themes#1
records.source: A night theme is one choice that moves three things at once: the colours the interface is painted in (:data:`spacr.qt.theme.THEMES` grows by ten because of this module), which ambient animation runs behind it and in which colours (:mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient`), and which set of sounds spaCR plays if the user has ever switched sound on (:mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth`). Choosing one in Preferences therefore changes how spaCR looks *and* how it sounds, which is the whole point of the family.
records.context: A night theme is one choice that moves three things at once: the colours the interface is painted in (:data:`spacr.qt.theme.THEMES` grows by ten because of this module), which ambient animation runs behind it and in which colours (:mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient`), and which set of sounds spaCR plays if the user has ever switched sound on (:mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth`). Choosing one in Preferences therefore changes how spaCR looks *and* how it sounds, which is the whole point of the family.
records.translation: 야간 테마는 세 가지를 한꺼번에 바꾸는 하나의 선택입니다. 인터페이스를 칠하는 색상(이 모듈 때문에 :data:`spacr.qt.theme.THEMES` 가 열 개 늘어남), 뒤에서 실행되는 주변 애니메이션과 그 색상(:mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient`), 그리고 사용자가 소리를 한 번이라도 켰다면 spaCR 이 재생하는 사운드 세트(:mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth`)입니다. 따라서 Preferences 에서 하나를 선택하면 spaCR 의 모습*과* 소리가 함께 바뀌며, 이것이 이 테마 계열의 핵심입니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.night_themes#2
records.source: This module is Qt-free on purpose, the same way :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` is: :mod:`spacr.qt.preferences` imports it to validate a stored theme name and must not pull QtGui or QtWidgets in while doing so. It holds data and three lookups and imports nothing from the rest of spaCR, so :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`, :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient` and :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` can all read from it without a cycle.
records.context: This module is Qt-free on purpose, the same way :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` is: :mod:`spacr.qt.preferences` imports it to validate a stored theme name and must not pull QtGui or QtWidgets in while doing so. It holds data and three lookups and imports nothing from the rest of spaCR, so :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`, :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient` and :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` can all read from it without a cycle.
records.translation: 이 모듈은 :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` 와 마찬가지로 의도적으로 Qt 에 의존하지 않습니다. :mod:`spacr.qt.preferences` 는 저장된 테마 이름을 검증하기 위해 이 모듈을 가져오는데, 그 과정에서 QtGui 나 QtWidgets 를 끌어들여서는 안 됩니다. 이 모듈은 데이터와 세 가지 조회 함수만 가지며 spaCR 의 나머지 부분에서 아무것도 가져오지 않으므로, :mod:`spacr.qt.theme`, :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.ambient`, :mod:`spacr.qt.sound_synth` 모두 순환 없이 이를 읽을 수 있습니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.night_themes#3
records.source: THE PALETTES ARE LITERALS RATHER THAN A RECIPE. Each one was generated from a hue and a saturation over a shared lightness ramp, then checked against :func:`spacr.qt.theme.contrast_failures` and :func:`spacr.qt.theme.page_separation_failures` and written down. Keeping the numbers here rather than the recipe means the published colours are the reviewed colours, no solver runs at import, and ``tests/qt/test_ten_night_themes.py`` judges what actually ships.
records.context: The palettes are literals rather than a recipe. Each one was generated from a hue and a saturation over a shared lightness ramp, then checked against :func:`spacr.qt.theme.contrast_failures` and :func:`spacr.qt.theme.page_separation_failures` and written down. Keeping the numbers here rather than the recipe means the published colours are the reviewed colours, no solver runs at import, and ``tests/qt/test_ten_night_themes.py`` judges what actually ships.
records.translation: 팔레트는 공식이 아니라 리터럴입니다. 각 팔레트는 공유 명도 단계에 대해 색상과 채도로 생성한 뒤, :func:`spacr.qt.theme.contrast_failures` 와 :func:`spacr.qt.theme.page_separation_failures` 로 검사하고 적어 두었습니다. 공식이 아니라 숫자를 여기에 두면 게시된 색상이 곧 검토된 색상이 되고, 가져올 때 솔버가 실행되지 않으며, ``tests/qt/test_ten_night_themes.py`` 는 실제로 배포되는 것을 판정합니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.night_themes#4
records.source: THREE COLOURS WERE MOVED OFF THE RECIPE BY MEASUREMENT, and they are the only three. records.source: The run sound is asked for only when :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` is already loaded, which it is exactly when sound has been switched on: the engine is built by ``apply_sound_preferences`` at launch and after every Save, and without an engine :func:`spacr.qt.sound.announce_run_end` is a no-op anyway. Importing it here unconditionally cost 20.4 ms on the GUI thread at the first run that ended, for a user who had never asked for sound.
records.context: The run sound is asked for only when :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` is already loaded, which it is exactly when sound has been switched on: the engine is built by ``apply_sound_preferences`` at launch and after every Save, and without an engine :func:`spacr.qt.sound.announce_run_end` is a no-op anyway. Importing it here unconditionally cost 20.4 ms on the main GUI execution path at the first run that ended, for a user who had never asked for sound.
records.translation: 처리 세션 사운드는 :mod:`spacr.qt.sound` 가 이미 로드되어 있을 때만 요청하며, 이는 정확히 소리를 켰을 때입니다. 엔진은 시작 시와 Save 할 때마다 ``apply_sound_preferences`` 가 만들며, 엔진이 없으면 :func:`spacr.qt.sound.announce_run_end` 는 어차피 아무 일도 하지 않습니다. 여기서 무조건 가져오면, 소리를 요청한 적이 없는 사용자에게도 첫 처리 세션이 끝날 때 GUI 실행 경로에서 20.4 ms 가 들었습니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.ops_stitch_demo#5
records.source: WHY THE OPS SAMPLE IS THE WELL'S LAST TWO SITES. The engine takes a well's field count as its highest site number plus one and fits the round well to that count, so a sample has to include the last site to keep the measured 333-field layout; see :func:`spacr.ops_engine.run_ops`. And it carries no phenotype images, because the phenotype phase aligns anchors spread over the whole well, which a two-field sample cannot supply.
records.context: Why the ops sample is the well's last two sites. The engine takes a well's microscope field of view count as its highest site number plus one and fits the round well to that count, so a sample has to include the last site to keep the measured 333-microscope field of view layout; see :func:`spacr.ops_engine.run_ops`. And it carries no phenotype images, because the phenotype phase aligns anchors spread over the whole well, which a two-microscope field of view sample cannot supply.
records.translation: OPS 샘플이 시료 위치의 마지막 두 사이트인 이유. 엔진은 시료 위치의 현미경 시야 수를 가장 큰 사이트 번호에 하나를 더한 값으로 보고 둥근 시료 위치를 그 수에 맞추므로, 측정된 333 개 현미경 시야 배치를 유지하려면 샘플에 마지막 사이트가 포함되어야 합니다. :func:`spacr.ops_engine.run_ops` 를 참조하십시오. 또한 표현형 이미지는 담고 있지 않습니다. 표현형 단계는 시료 위치 전체에 퍼진 기준점을 정렬하는데, 현미경 시야 두 개짜리 샘플로는 이를 제공할 수 없기 때문입니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.organelle_modes#1
records.source: spaCR already implements eight ways of finding an object -- ``otsu``, ``adaptive``, ``log``, ``dog``, ``ridge``, ``hysteresis``, ``cellpose`` and ``unet`` -- in :func:`spacr.object.generate_organelle_masks_sam`. Make Masks offered two of them. A curator correcting a mask of tubules had Otsu and Cellpose; the ridge filter that would have found the tubules was three screens away, in a batch pipeline, and could not be tried on the field in front of them.
records.context: spaCR already implements eight ways of finding an object -- ``otsu``, ``adaptive``, ``log``, ``dog``, ``ridge``, ``hysteresis``, ``cellpose`` and ``unet`` -- in :func:`spacr.object.generate_organelle_masks_sam`. Make Masks offered two of them. A curator correcting a mask of tubules had Otsu and Cellpose; the ridge filter that would have found the tubules was three screens away, in a batch workflow, and could not be tried on the microscope field of view in front of them.
records.translation: spaCR 은 이미 객체를 찾는 여덟 가지 방법(``otsu``, ``adaptive``, ``log``, ``dog``, ``ridge``, ``hysteresis``, ``cellpose``, ``unet``)을 :func:`spacr.object.generate_organelle_masks_sam` 에 구현하고 있습니다. Make Masks 는 그중 두 가지만 제공했습니다. 세관 마스크를 수정하는 큐레이터에게는 Otsu 와 Cellpose 가 있었지만, 세관을 찾아 주었을 ridge 필터는 세 화면 떨어진 일괄 처리 워크플로에 있어서 눈앞의 현미경 시야에 시험해 볼 수 없었습니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.organelle_modes#2
records.source: THIS MODULE IS A BRIDGE AND NOT A SECOND IMPLEMENTATION. Every classical method runs through :func:`spacr.object._segment_single_image`, the one the organelle pipeline's workers call, and ``unet`` through :func:`spacr.object._segment_unet`. So "adaptive" means in Make Masks exactly what it means in a mask run, and a curator who tunes a block size on one field is tuning the setting the pipeline will read. The whole of this module's own work is naming the parameters, turning them into the ``organelle_*`` keys that engine reads, and saying what each method suits.
records.context: This module is a bridge and not a second implementation. Every classical method executes through :func:`spacr.object._segment_single_image`, the one the organelle workflow's workers call, and ``unet`` through :func:`spacr.object._segment_unet`. So "adaptive" means in Make Masks exactly what it means in a mask run, and a curator who tunes a block size on one microscope field of view is tuning the setting the workflow will read. The whole of this module's own work is naming the parameters, turning them into the ``organelle_*`` structured-data names that engine reads, and saying what each method suits.
records.translation: 이 모듈은 두 번째 구현이 아니라 연결 다리입니다. 모든 고전적 방법은 소기관 워크플로의 작업자가 호출하는 :func:`spacr.object._segment_single_image` 를 거쳐 실행되고, ``unet`` 은 :func:`spacr.object._segment_unet` 을 거칩니다. 따라서 Make Masks 에서 "adaptive" 는 마스크 처리 세션에서와 정확히 같은 뜻이며, 한 현미경 시야에서 블록 크기를 조정하는 큐레이터는 워크플로가 읽을 설정을 조정하는 것입니다. 이 모듈 자체가 하는 일은 매개변수에 이름을 붙이고, 이를 엔진이 읽는 ``organelle_*`` 키로 바꾸고, 각 방법이 무엇에 적합한지 알려 주는 것이 전부입니다.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.organelle_modes#3
records.source: WHICH MORPHOLOGY A MODE RUNS UNDER. The organelle engine dispatches on ``organelle_morphology`` FIRST and the method second, because the same word means different code for different shapes. Make Masks has no morphology box -- a curator picks a detector, not a cell-biology category -- so each mode names the morphology whose branch implements that method in the form a curator of whole objects wants, and :data:`MODE_MORPHOLOGY` is that choice written down:

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measure_input_table#1
records.source: The one control the Measure module has no equivalent of. Measure reads a ``merged/`` folder a pipeline already built, and everything about which file is which channel was decided by the plate's naming convention long before Measure saw it. A user who drew masks with a mouse has no naming convention and no pipeline, so the question has to be asked, and this is where it is asked: one row per field, one column per channel and per mask type, and three ways to fill a cell -- drop files on it, click it and browse, or write one regex that fills the whole table at once.
records.context: The one control the Measure module has no equivalent of. Measure reads a ``merged/`` folder a workflow already built, and everything about which file is which image data channel was decided by the laboratory microplate's naming convention long before Measure saw it. A user who drew masks with a mouse has no naming convention and no workflow, so the question has to be asked, and this is where it is asked: one row per microscope field of view, one column per image data channel and per mask type, and three ways to fill a cell -- drop files on it, click it and browse, or write one regex that fills the whole table at once.
records.translation: Measure 모듈에는 대응하는 것이 없는 유일한 컨트롤입니다. Measure 는 워크플로가 이미 만든 ``merged/`` 폴더를 읽으며, 어떤 파일이 어떤 채널인지는 Measure 가 보기 훨씬 전에 플레이트의 명명 규칙으로 정해졌습니다. 마우스로 마스크를 그린 사용자에게는 명명 규칙도 워크플로도 없으므로 물어봐야 하며, 여기가 그 질문을 하는 곳입니다: 현미경 시야마다 한 행, 채널과 마스크 유형마다 한 열, 그리고 셀을 채우는 세 가지 방법 -- 파일을 끌어다 놓기, 클릭하여 찾아보기, 또는 표 전체를 한 번에 채우는 정규식 하나 작성.

Everything here is a list of strings; the ``isdir`` and ``listdir`` that turn a dropped folder into files run on this widget's own worker (:func:`files_under`), because a drop is a path the user chose and on a microscope rig that is the share the images live on -- one stat under a sleeping ``autofs`` mount was measured at over twenty seconds, on the thread that paints.

Everything here is a list of strings; the ``isdir`` and ``listdir`` that turn a dropped folder into files run on this widget's own worker (:func:`files_under`), because a drop is a path the user chose and on a microscope rig that is the share the images live on -- one stat under a sleeping ``autofs`` mount was measured at over twenty seconds, on the independent execution path that paints.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurements_example#1
records.source: The Annotate example (``einarolafsson/spacr-example-annotate``) is a real plate: ``measurements/measurements.db`` with its cell, cytoplasm, nucleus and pathogen tables, and the 2,341 crops under ``data/`` it indexes. Annotate and Classify already fetch it into the shared example plate folder (:func:`spacr.example_archives.example_plate_folder`). Every other screen that opens a measurements database can be shown working on the same plate, so this module fetches it once and hands it to whichever screen asked.
records.context: The Annotate example (``einarolafsson/spacr-example-annotate``) is a real plate: ``measurements/measurements.db`` with its cell, cytoplasm, nucleus and pathogen tables, and the 2,341 extracted image regions under ``data/`` it indexes. Annotate and Classify already fetch it into the shared example plate folder (:func:`spacr.example_archives.example_plate_folder`). Every other application view that opens a measurements database can be shown working on the same plate, so this module fetches it once and hands it to whichever application view asked.
records.translation: Annotate 예제(``einarolafsson/spacr-example-annotate``)는 실제 플레이트입니다: 세포, 세포질, 핵, 병원체 테이블을 가진 ``measurements/measurements.db`` 와, 그것이 색인하는 ``data/`` 아래의 추출된 이미지 영역 2,341 개. Annotate 와 Classify 는 이미 이를 공유 예제 플레이트 폴더(:func:`spacr.example_archives.example_plate_folder`)로 가져옵니다. 측정 데이터베이스를 여는 다른 모든 화면도 같은 플레이트로 동작하는 모습을 보여 줄 수 있으므로, 이 모듈이 한 번 가져와 요청한 화면에 넘겨줍니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurements_example#2
records.source: ONE HELPER, NOT ONE COPY PER SCREEN. The cached-or-download decision, the button's busy state and the failure message are the same for Plate Viewer, Tabulate, Graph Builder and the rest; what differs is only which field is filled and which method opens it. So a screen passes that one difference as a callback and nothing else.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker#4
records.source: WHY THE LIST HAS FIVE HEADINGS RATHER THAN A BOOLEAN. It used to be one list with "show unvetted community uploads" beside it -- a control that could fold away exactly one of the catalogue's five origins. With ten models trained here, four stock Cellpose-SAM backbones, bioimage.io's collection, the Cellpose 3 backend's own four and a shared catalogue, a user who wanted the ten and not the rest had no way to say so. :class:`SourceStrip` is the five origins as five clickable names, each one blue when its rows are on screen and muted when they are folded away, remembered between openings. The warning the boolean carried is unchanged and still arrives before the first unvetted row does -- see :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.
records.context: Why the list has five headings rather than a boolean. It used to be one list with "show unvetted community uploads" beside it -- a control that could fold away exactly one of the catalogue's five origins. With ten models trained here, four stock Cellpose-SAM backbones, bioimage.io's collection, the Cellpose 3 backend's own four and a shared catalogue, a user who wanted the ten and not the rest had no way to say so. :class:`SourceStrip` is the five origins as five clickable names, each one blue when its rows are on application view and muted when they are folded away, remembered between openings. The warning the boolean carried is unchanged and still arrives before the first unvetted row does -- see :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.
records.translation: 목록에 불리언 대신 제목이 다섯 개인 이유. 예전에는 목록 하나 옆에 "show unvetted community uploads" 가 있었는데, 카탈로그의 다섯 출처 중 정확히 하나만 접을 수 있는 컨트롤이었습니다. 여기서 학습한 모델 열 개, 기본 Cellpose-SAM 백본 네 개, bioimage.io 의 컬렉션, Cellpose 3 백엔드 자체의 모델 네 개, 공유 카탈로그가 있는 상황에서 열 개만 원하고 나머지는 원하지 않는 사용자는 그렇게 말할 방법이 없었습니다. :class:`SourceStrip` 은 다섯 출처를 클릭할 수 있는 다섯 이름으로 보여 주며, 각 이름은 그 행이 화면에 있으면 파란색, 접혀 있으면 흐리게 표시되고 열 때마다 기억됩니다. 불리언이 담던 경고는 바뀌지 않았고 여전히 첫 번째 검증되지 않은 행보다 먼저 나타납니다 -- :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source` 를 참조하십시오.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker.BackendInstallDialog#1
records.source: WHAT IT CHANGES, SAID BEFORE IT CHANGES IT. A backend installs into an environment of its own under ``~/.spacr/backends``; spaCR's own environment is never touched, so nothing here can stop spaCR starting. The dialog says where it goes, what it downloads, how large it is and under what licence before Install is pressed.
records.context: What it changes, said before it changes it. A backend installs into an environment of its own under ``~/.spacr/backends``; spaCR's own environment is never touched, so nothing here can stop spaCR starting. The dialog says where it goes, what it downloads, how large it is and under what licence before Install is pressed.
records.translation: 무엇을 바꾸는지, 바꾸기 전에 말합니다. 백엔드는 ``~/.spacr/backends`` 아래의 자체 환경에 설치됩니다. spaCR 자체 환경은 절대 건드리지 않으므로, 여기서 하는 어떤 일도 spaCR 의 시작을 막을 수 없습니다. 대화 상자는 Install 을 누르기 전에 설치 위치, 다운로드 내용, 크기, 라이선스를 알려 줍니다.

records.context: The application view behind it can follow it. :attr:`job_started`, :attr:`job_progressed`, :attr:`job_failed` and :attr:`job_cancelled` tell the widget that opened the dialog what the install is doing, so a button can say "installing" while it executes and a console can say why it failed after the dialog has gone.
records.translation: 뒤의 화면이 이를 따라갈 수 있습니다. :attr:`job_started`, :attr:`job_progressed`, :attr:`job_failed`, :attr:`job_cancelled` 는 대화 상자를 연 위젯에 설치가 무엇을 하고 있는지 알려 주므로, 버튼은 실행 중에 "installing" 이라고 표시하고 콘솔은 대화 상자가 사라진 뒤에도 실패 이유를 알릴 수 있습니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker.BackendInstallDialog#11
records.source: IT BELONGS TO THE WINDOW, NOT THE WIDGET THAT ASKED (item 521). A dialog inherits the style sheet of every widget above it, and Plaque Assay asks from its preview, whose own scale slider re-states the application sheet at that preview's scale: at 150 % Install and Cancel were 59 px tall, not the 40 px of every other button. Parented to ``parent.window()`` it is themed like every other dialog and still centred on, and modal to, the window that opened it.

The install -- a venv, then pip, often for minutes -- runs on a worker thread; the dialog shows which step it is on and pip's latest line, and Cancel stops pip and everything it started and removes the half-built environment. A failure shows the failing command's own output, verbatim.
